title: Ident
description: A brand ident for the first or last second: a wide-tracked thin wordmark lights up letter by letter, a thin gold rule draws from the centre, one small line settles under it. Quiet on purpose.

props.name: required, the wordmark, 1-3 words
props.line: one small line under the rule
props.small: a tiny gold word under that, for example PRESENTS
